result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with cut-off content in a carousel, and a minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right edge, obscuring the restaurant name and delivery information
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel layout to either show complete cards with proper spacing, add visible scroll indicators, or implement proper overflow handling so all content is fully visible or clearly scrollable

issues.description: Restaurant name appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' which is likely incomplete (probably should be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar)
issues.suggestion: Ensure full restaurant names are displayed by either increasing available space or implementing text ellipsis with a tooltip to show the complete name
